methods.label: Use the sign inside the absolute value
methods.explanation:
Because \(x<2\), the expression \(x-2\) is negative. Its absolute value is therefore its opposite:
\[
p=|x-2|=-(x-2)=2-x.
\]
Rearranging gives \(x=2-p\), so
\[
x-p=(2-p)-p=\boxed{2-2p}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
